title: Staging CORS authorization for the protected tina-ai Vercel Preview origin
decision: PHASE 10A4B PRE1 PASS WITH STRICT RECOMMENDATIONS
rootCause: security/cors-policy.js authorizes only exact origins from the staging CORS_ORIGIN/ALLOWED_ORIGINS env allowlist and fails closed otherwise (correct). The allowlist contained the production origin but not the ephemeral, per-deployment Vercel Preview origin, so the browser blocked all credentialed Preview->staging requests.

remediation.change: Added a staging-ONLY authorization branch for the owner-team-anchored, SSO-protected tina-ai Preview origin. Gated on server-injected Render markers (RENDER_SERVICE_NAME/RENDER_EXTERNAL_URL), NOT the client Host header. https-only; anchored to the owner's globally-unique Vercel team suffix; 'tina-' project prefix; exact ($) hostname anchors prevent suffix/lookalike injection. Reflects only the specific pattern-validated origin (never a wildcard with credentials). Never applies on production.
remediation.decisionOrder: Config (priority 1: add the stable Preview alias to staging ALLOWED_ORIGINS) is the ideal minimal fix but requires Render dashboard access not available to the executor; there is no committed render.yaml. Option 3 (strictly constrained canonical tina-ai Preview-host validation) was therefore implemented as the narrowest self-contained, deployable, testable path.
remediation.productionSafety: The new branch is gated to the staging runtime; production CORS behavior is unchanged (verified live: production origin still granted; the exact env allowlist still governs).

preflightMatrix.note: Live OPTIONS /login against tina-backend-staging with each Origin (raw origins never printed).

browserSmoke.note: Real headless Chrome with web security ENABLED. Bypass cookie for the protected Preview; login through the actual UI; one sanitized authenticated GET /conversations from the browser returned 200 with no CORS error.

regression.preExistingUnrelatedFailure: tests/phase-09zf-...: a self-referential guard requiring pipeline.js in the LAST commit; fails for any commit that is not the 09ZF commit (also fails at baseline 65f9a34). Not introduced by this task.

productionSafety.productionOriginUsage: only as an Origin header on a preflight to STAGING (control); no request was made to any production deployment

strictRecommendations: Tighten to an EXACT-origin allowlist of the stable Preview branch alias in the staging ALLOWED_ORIGINS env (priority-1 config) once Render dashboard access is available; then the code branch can be narrowed or removed.
The current code branch is team-SCOPED (authorizes owner-team tina-* previews, including the sibling 'tina' project); the exact-origin config is narrower.
The staging gate relies on Render service identifiers; re-verify if the staging service is renamed.
Gate-hygiene: the pre-existing phase-09zf self-referential last-commit guard fails for any non-09ZF HEAD and should be repaired separately.
nextRequiredStep: Mandatory Opus 4.8 low-speed independent review of this remediation. On pass, PHASE-10A4B representative rendered validation may be re-run against the Preview branch alias / preview origin (now CORS-authorized on staging).
